repair_scope.actual_controls: Eight isolated stdlib cases passed. The repaired owner main/admission entry was not executed; fixed basename/parser and downstream reference binding were source reviewed.
repair_scope.durable_first_failure: One exclusive 65536-byte-capped journal and explicit readback before cleanup; original primary and saved stop precede persistence; persistence/cleanup errors remain secondary.
repair_scope.persistence_deadline: At most one second and no later than the already saved cleanup end; scoped SIGALRM restored. Uninterruptible kernel I/O is not claimed hard-bounded.
repair_scope.unchanged_native_acceptance: Accepted PROBE_02 native code and callbacks are unchanged; its successful native result is retained without replay.

scope: One future owner-launched ordinary native-only external-DRS operation through the exact candidate launcher, ordinary entry and repaired supervisor. This review authorizes preparation of the command, not execution by the engineering agents.

timing_basis.interpretation: Caps are finite planning margins over a two-Work probe with a real restart, not a measured five-Work owner duration or an ETA. The full owner operation may fail honestly on its source/status/window or semantic-progress limits; no renewal or retry is authorized.
